ussea-basic.subject: Welcome to USSEA — Your membership is active
ussea-basic.html:
You’re in. Let’s start skating.

Hi {{first_name}},

Your Skateboard Basic Membership is now active. Your course materials are ready and waiting.

Sign in below and you’ll be taken straight to your member dashboard where you can launch your first lesson.

Start Your Course

If you have any questions, reply to this email or reach us at biruh.alemnew@ussea.us.

Glad to have you with us.

— The USSEA Team

ussea-instructor.subject: Welcome to USSEA — Your instructor certification is ready
ussea-instructor.html:
Your instructor certification awaits.

Hi {{first_name}},

Your USSEA Instructor Certification is now active. You have full access to all certification course materials.

Complete your coursework to earn your official USSEA instructor credential. Sign in below to get started.

You also have safety certification requirements to complete before working with athletes. You can view and track them in your member portal once you sign in.

Start Your Course

If you have any questions, reply to this email or reach us at biruh.alemnew@ussea.us.

Glad to have you with us.

— The USSEA Team

ussea-org.subject: Welcome to USSEA — Your organization membership is active
ussea-org.html:
Your organization is set up.

Hi {{first_name}},

Your USSEA Organization Membership is now active. As the account admin, you can add instructors, coaches, and basic members from your organization directly from your dashboard.

Once you add a member, they’ll automatically receive an email with instructions to access their courses — no extra steps needed on their end.

Sign in below to go to your dashboard and start adding your team.

Go to Your Dashboard

If you have any questions, reply to this email or reach us at biruh.alemnew@ussea.us.

Glad to have you with us.

— The USSEA Team
